# Cozy understory assets

Source: [Kenney Nature Kit](https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit), downloaded 2026-10-03.
License: CC0; see License.txt.

Archive SHA256: `fa7974a0d342bfe63c38664ba9f8ec1a4aab8ea25f099bdc56870e33588c4d9d`.

Added unmodified OBJ/MTL sources: `plant_bushSmall`, `plant_bushDetailed`, `grass_leafs`, `grass_leafsLarge`, `flower_purpleA`, `flower_yellowB`.

The focused Unity menu “Quiet Camp/Build Cozy Vegetation Library” normalizes these meshes into a resource library. Runtime geometry is batched, colored with the camp palette and moved by the shared wind shader; no third-party scripts or physics are imported.
